decisions.reason: As a large bulk container, it sits directly in the firm's core reusable packaging and engineering knowledge base, so management is likely to keep it and refine it rather than exit after only one year.

The bulk-container valve is a closely related add-on to the firm's container business, and its strong fit with existing design, manufacturing, and customer applications makes continued commercialization more likely than withdrawal.

Although newer and less prominently presented, the used packaging take-back service strongly matches the firm's shift toward service-based, circular, reusable packaging and can be improved through its existing operations and customer relationships.
